text: Farmers in Maharashtra are not receiving the Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi funds despite submitting documents
Irrigation canal in Rajasthan has been blocked for 3 months and crops are dying due to water shortage

Pest attack on paddy crops in West Bengal is causing severe losses with no government support available
Cold storage facility in Himachal Pradesh is non-functional resulting in apple farmers losing their produce

Minimum support price for wheat in Madhya Pradesh is not being paid to farmers at procurement centers
Water scarcity in drought-hit regions of Karnataka is severely affecting agricultural production and livelihoods
Government hospital in UP has no doctors present for the last one week and patients are suffering
Medicine shortage at district hospital in Bihar has left dengue patients without proper treatment
Ambulance service in rural Tamil Nadu is non-functional leaving emergency patients with no transport

State highway in Uttar Pradesh has potholes that have caused multiple accidents in the last month

Street lights on the main road of a town in West Bengal have not been working for 3 months
Newly constructed road in Rajasthan has already developed cracks due to poor quality construction material
Pedestrian footpath in Chennai is broken and senior citizens are at risk of falling and getting injured
Dust from an unmaintained road in Haryana is causing health issues to residents in nearby areas
Road digging was done for laying pipes in Maharashtra but the road was not restored causing traffic jams

Electricity pole fell on a house in Bihar and no repair team has come for a week causing danger

New electricity connection application in Madhya Pradesh is pending for 6 months with no update
Solar panels installed under a government scheme in Himachal Pradesh are non-functional from day one
